title: Cheaply made.  Not durable at all.
text: Cheaply made.  Not durable at all.. These seem sturdy with the supportive cardboard inside the walls.  The one star is because the decorative "cloth" is more of a fiber, paper item.  I pulled on the handles to remove from the box and the side tore.  Very fragile.  Don't plan to put any weight in these as the handle will tear the side when lifting.

description: Take Back Your Space with DII Storage Bins
Non-Woven storage bins are a fun and creative way to organize and store toys, clothes, blankets, towels, books, knick knacks and more. Tired of clutter in the kids room, living room, or laundry room?
These storage containers could be the perfect solution to organize the clutter while enhancing your home’s décor.

Get creative with fun designs and colors that are easy to mix and match. Bring color and interest to a dull room with vibrant hues and a sophisticated look while also adding functionality. Designed to fit into standard cube organizers these trendy bins can offer stylish solutions to store kid clothes and toys, hide knick knacks, hold books, magazines, games, craft supplies or anything else that needs its own spot.
Good for the Budget & Built for Your Lifestyle

DII cube bins are created to fit any cube organizer, folding flat when not in use. Sold as a set of two or four (for selected patterns) these are easy on your wallet and a great solution for storage, especially in a spall space. These bins work great in a college dorm, studio or small apartment, or a house that could use extra storage space. Don’t have a cub organizer, you don’t need one, these bins will fit on shelves, under beds, in closets, or furniture and you’re sure to find a design that fits your personality.
